hypothesis: A sub-24 uniform base retains enough causal state to reach the declared get_weather final-token prefix, after which the measured schema discriminator can spend one Budget96 routed position and preserve a valid tool call.

control.generated_ids_sha256_contract: Use the retained r68 committed-token trace; token equality is reported separately from tool validity.

policies.required_if: Budget16 returns a valid get_weather call
Budget12 returns a valid get_weather call

validity: All executed arms use one clean source commit and one executable hash, the frozen official-template prompt hash, no static position override and no request-wide Budget96 floor.
Each policy file has exactly layers 1 through 92 at the declared uniform budget and matches its preregistered SHA-256.
A passing arm emits exactly one schema-rescue marker. Its base position must equal prompt_count plus the zero-based generated index of the second trigger-suffix token.
A passing arm returns exactly one native-valid get_weather call with JSON argument location San Francisco.
Report full generated IDs and exact equality versus Budget24 independently from tool validity.
Report logical provider, selected-sidecar, provider exact-fallback and physical direct-read bytes over every provider position.

gates.budget16: GO below Budget24 only if valid tool output and logical GiB/position is below the measured Budget24 control.
gates.budget12: GO for the <0.8 milestone only if valid tool output and logical GiB/position is <0.8; otherwise report the measured point without relabeling it.
gates.budget8: GO for the <=0.53 storage regime only if valid tool output and logical GiB/position is <=0.53; otherwise report the measured point without relabeling it.
gates.stop: Stop at the first invalid tool arm. Do not add positions, alter trigger tokens or tune the selector on this fixture.

limitations: One tool fixture cannot establish broad behavior or reliability.
No terminal full-vocabulary KL teacher capture is included.
A successful schema boundary does not prove coding, reasoning or structured-output retention at the same base budget.
Cold token-sequential timing is not serving throughput.
